answer: The Harbor Beacon Audit runs in four steps. First, each new agent locks a 500-POA bond. Second, every epoch a random 2% face an audit: three established peers verify hardware identity. Third, failures lose the bond and get struck off. Fourth, auditors split 15% of each slashed bond, so watching pays. Running 10,000 fakes locks 5,000,000 POA, and a 2% audit rate surfaces about 200 each epoch, each burning 500 more POA. A sybil farmer climbs a canyon of locked bonds before earning a cent. The audit is a beacon sweeping a foggy ocean strait: every dark ship crosses the light eventually.
